notes.walkaround: With power off, walk around the vehicle. Check seals, connectors and thruster guards at each station. Report anything wrong.
notes.power: Energise shore power, then power on the vehicle. Watch status lamps and listen for the boot chime.
notes.thrusters: Keep clear of thrusters. Pulse each for 2 s; total dry run must stay under 30 s.
notes.lights: Turn lights on, confirm both lamps light the deck, then turn them off; do not leave them on long in air.
notes.camera: Feed is on the onboard camera: confirm image, sharp focus and a running clock.

lookFor: Cracks or dirt on the camera dome and lamp covers.
Fouling on thrusters; cracks in guards.
Sand or hair on the end-cap seal face or O-ring.
Tether connector locking collar fully seated.
Fouling on thrusters; cracks in guards.

defects.line_fouled: A length of rope is hung on the thruster guard
defects.oring_debris: Sand and hair on the seal face
defects.connector_unlocked: Tether connector locking collar not fully locked

fixes.line_fouled: Cut the rope and clear the guard.
fixes.oring_debris: Open the end cap, clean the O-ring and re-grease.
fixes.connector_unlocked: Turn the locking collar all the way home.

waitTender: Wait for the tether hand to report the tether ready.
lowerNote: Pick an upstream launch point and lower on the lift line; arm only after the vehicle is in the water and personnel are clear.
skip: Skip remaining checks (penalty; undiscovered defects go into the water)
